lead_raw_text:
The structure of MgMn2(PO5)2 crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with a 22-atom unit cell and six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies P centers as tetrahedral (four O neighbors, 1.563–1.567 Å) and Mn centers as octahedral (six O neighbors, 1.949–2.279 Å). Polyhedron-sharing analysis reveals corner-sharing between Mn octahedra and P tetrahedra, and both corner- and edge-sharing among Mn octahedra. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 22 sites.
